meta.name: Girih-inspired 14-fold substitution (Pautze 2017 / Bielefeld Tilings Encyclopedia)
meta.frame: canonical parent frame: parent vertices CP[i] = lambda * CV[cls][i], child edge = 1; all coordinates are twist pairs (P,Q) in (1/2)Z[zeta_14], z = P + i*sin(pi/7)*Q; t6 = doubled (2P0,2P1,2P2,2Q0,2Q1,2Q2) as ints

lambda.note: lambda = 2b^2+3b (triple 3b+2b^2), b=2cos(2pi/7), minpoly b^3+b^2-2b-1; Norm(lambda) = -7 (NOT a unit of K7); lambda approx 6.850855075327

meta.twist_mul: (P1,Q1)*(P2,Q2) = (P1*P2 - s2*Q1*Q2, P1*Q2 + Q1*P2) with s2 = (2-b)/4 = (1/2, -1/4, 0); K7 mul is the Z[b] product reduced by b^3 = 1+2b-b^2; implement dyadically (integer coeffs over 2^e, per-point normalization - see glb_binary_n7.rs Tw)

rot_table_t6.note: zeta_14^k as twist pairs, DOUBLED coords (divide by 2); rot_j(z) = twist_mul(z, rot_table_t6[j]); rot_7 = (-1,0) = point reflection; mirror = (P,-Q)

meta.levels: tile instance = (cls, scale s, orientation (J,M), anchor t): vertices t + s*g(CV[cls]); level-n scale s = lambda^n (level-0 seed at scale 1). The rule is drawn with parent scale lambda, kid scale 1: substituting a parent of scale s yields kids of scale s/lambda.
meta.kid_transport: world kid placement for parent (t_p, Jp, Mp, scale s): corner i = parent_vertex_i + (s/lambda)*g_p(G14REL); edge i = midpoint_i + (s/lambda)*g_p(FAM[dir_i]) (equivalently midpoint_i + (s/lambda)*FAM[dir'], dir' = transported direction; g_p(FAM[d]) = FAM[d'] verified); interior (kid,j,m,t_k) = t_p + (s/lambda)*( g_p(t_k) + (g_p o g_k)(CV[kid]) ), composition g_p o g_k = (Jp + (Mp ? -j : j) mod 14, Mp XOR m); s/lambda = lambda^(n-1) in K7, exact
meta.module_closure: lambda * (1/2 Z[zeta_14]) subset (1/2 Z[zeta_14]) (lambda integral in K7; lambda*zeta^k has integral cos and sin-ratio parts), so all levels stay in the module with the single edge-direction family zeta^k
meta.dedup: emit whole kids (corner 14-gons and edge decagons straddle); dedup emitted tiles by exact vertex set (class + sorted 6-int key); adjacent parents emit the SAME corner ring (global phase) and the SAME edge decagon (F_d == F_{d+7} verified)
errata: Bielefeld page claims lambda 'is a unit' - FALSE: Norm(lambda) = -7
Pau2017 Table 7 n=7 row (5.801939) contradicted by the paper's own Figs 7.4/7.5 (measured 6.8507)
URL hygiene: page slug is 'girih-14fold' (hyphenated), image dir is /img/substitution/girih14-fold/ (no hyphen)

corner_kid.rule: for each parent vertex i: 14-gon centered at CP[i] with vertices CP[i] + R*zeta_m, m=0..13 (GLOBAL phase - module membership forces this unique set); wedge inside the parent at vertex i = k_i/14 of the 14-gon where k_i = CYC[cls][i]; sum k_i = 7*(nv-2)

edge_kid.rule: each parent edge i (parent edge-cyclic order) carries one full D2 decagon instance listed in rules[cls].edge[i] as (j,m,t6): vertices = t/2 + rot_j(mirror_m(CV[D2])) in rule coords - geometrically it is centered at the exact edge midpoint (CP[i]+CP[i+1])/2, EXACTLY mirror-symmetric across the parent edge line, and half of it lies inside the parent; adjacent parents share the edge and emit the identical decagon (F_d == F_{d+7} verified across all 110 edges), so dedup-by-vertex-set merges them

checks.exact_checks: corner rings == CP[i]+R*zeta^m (set-exact, all 110); edge decagon centers == exact midpoints (all 110); edge decagons exactly mirror-symmetric across parent edge line (all 110); one edge family per direction d with F_d == F_(d+7); interior kids inside-or-on parent + pairwise disjoint (exact K7 predicates) + no duplicates; N' matrix matches certified values; PF(N') = lambda^2 (spread 0)
checks.extraction_float_residuals: drawn-vs-exact registration residuals <= 1.0e-2 child units across all 11 panels (float used only for hypothesis matching; all stored placements are exact twist pairs)
